correctness.rationale: The support H(phi)=max(0,2cos(phi),cos(phi)+sin(phi),sin(phi)) and target reflected edge normals allow exact containment by four halfspaces. Their nonnegative dependence cone has precisely two extremal generators, producing two necessary-and-sufficient dilation thresholds W(t) (width) and Q(t) (three-side balance), where t=2theta. The piecewise exact width profile shows W<3/sqrt5 only on three explicitly identified angular intervals, where direct support branches prove Q>=3/sqrt5. At t=-atan(1/2), both equal 3/sqrt5, with other angular cases strictly larger, proving global value and uniqueness. Fresh independent support-function grid over 100001 orientations finds minimum 1.3416484 and exact analytic witness 1.3416407865; the proof of continuum bound comes from piecewise inequalities, not sampling.
